chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever leads a people in salat (prayer) while among them there is one who is more knowledgeable than him, their affair will continue in decline until the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.أَعْلَمُ: more knowledgeable and more qualified in religious knowledge
key_terms.أَمْرُهُمْ: their collective affair or communal condition
key_terms.بِقَوْمٍ: for a group or people in congregation

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about leading prayer when someone more knowledgeable is present?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that leadership in congregational salat (prayer) should be given to the one most qualified in knowledge. It warns that preferring a less knowledgeable leader over one more worthy leads a community toward decline, with consequences extending until the Day of Judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1102 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever leads a people in prayer while there is someone among them who is more knowledgeable than him, their affairs will continue to decline until the Day of Judgment."
